newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China GDP to grow 9.6 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China GDP to grow 9.6 pct in first half.

text.p: China's gross domestic product (GBP) is forecast to grow 9.6 percent year-on-year in the first half and show slightly faster growth in the second quarter compared with the first quarter, the Financial News said on Tuesday.

Total GDP in the first half was forecast at 3.35 trillion yuan, with primary industry accounting for more than 440 billion yuan, up by five percent, secondary industry for more than 1.75 trillion yuan, up by 12 percent and tertiary industry for more than 1.16 trillion yuan, up by eight percent, it said.
Industrial output was expected to grow 13 percent year-on-year, it said quoting a forecast by the Information Department of the State Economic and Trade Commission.

A strong consumer market would be one of the major factors in strong economic growth, it said. It forecast consumer sales to reach 1.315 trillion yuan in the first half, up 15 percent compared with the year-ago period.
China's economy grew by 9.7 percent last year and officials have set a target of eight percent for 1997 to try to cool the economy before it shows signs of overheating.
The economy grew by 9.4 percent in the first quarter.
